entities.name: Cathedral of Our Lady, Tromsø
entities.label: Institution
entities.summary: The Cathedral of Our Lady, also commonly known as the Church of Our Lady, is the Catholic cathedral of the city of Tromsø, Norway, and seat of the prelature of the same name. It is the northernmost Catholic cathedral in the world. It is located on the Erling Bangsunds square.
